newsitem.title: UK: Stagecoach skids on penalty worries.
newsitem.headline: Stagecoach skids on penalty worries.

text.p: Shares in Stagecoach Holdings Plc skidded 21-1/2p lower to 698-1/2 by 0855 GMT on continuing worries that the company could be hit by severe financial penalties due to train cancellations.
"The company's problems with its (train) drivers won't be sorted out anytime soon. The market is just a bit nervous about possible sanctions," one market maker said.
On Monday, the UK rail industry regulator said it was considering fining Stagecoach's South West Trains unit after a sharp rise in train cancellations over the past week due to a driver shortage.

A spokesman for the Office of Passenger Rail Franchising (OPRAF) said performance targets were built into franchise agreements but that no decision would be taken on the possibility of fining Stagecoach or the size of such fines until it has analysed its performance for the rest of February. --Dale Faulken, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
